summary.en: Output runs the command and returns its standard output.

name: exec.Cmd.Run

summary.th: Run starts the specified command and waits for it to complete.
summary.en: Run starts the specified command and waits for it to complete.

example:
cmd := exec.Command("sleep", "1")
log.Printf("Running command and waiting for it to finish...")
err := cmd.Run()
log.Printf("Command finished with error: %v", err)

name: exec.Cmd.Start

summary.th: Start starts the specified command but does not wait for it to complete.
summary.en: Start starts the specified command but does not wait for it to complete.

example:
cmd := exec.Command("sleep", "5")
err := cmd.Start()
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
log.Printf("Waiting for command to finish...")
err = cmd.Wait()
log.Printf("Command finished with error: %v", err)

	log.Fatal(err)
}
